data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'athal', meaning 'noble one'. In the Bible, Athaliah was a queen of Judah who attempted to usurp the throne after the death of her grandson. Her name is a reminder of nobility and strength. The name Athal carries the meaning “Noble one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Athal usually hope their child will grow to embody noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Its meaning - 'noble one' is indicative of the value placed on character, strength, and nobility in their society. This name would have been cherished and passed down from generation to generation as a symbol of pride in one's heritage and cultural identity.

The name Athal is a constant reminder that every individual possesses within them a unique nobility and potential for greatness, inherent from their spiritual origin.
